messages.author: Kankana Bhattacharjee
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I am trying to install amber24, but getting the issue while using "make
install". I have loaded the cmake 3.24.2 and gcc 9.2. But, installation is
not happening.
I am sharing the screenshot of the error message. It would be really great,
if you kindly look into it.
Thanks & Regards
Kankana Bhattacharjee
Ph.D. Scholar
Department of Chemistry
Ashoka University
Sonipat, Haryana

messages.author: David A Case
messages.body:

>I am sharing the screenshot of the error message. It would be really great,

I haven't seen this error before: you can see if there is a gfortran module
that you could load. You could also carry out a web search on the error
message "undefined gfortran_os_error_at".
...good luck...dac
